A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same GREAT framework, PIADv2 dataset and experiments, allowing reliable comparison of all supplied content. Neither contains appendix pages or embedded supplements, despite appendix cross-references; unavailable supplementary material cannot be compared.

before.justification: v1 reports original PIADv2 benchmark results and ablations in Tables 2–3, with qualitative experimental results in Figures 4–8.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark, ablation and qualitative results.

M1.justification: The documented MHACoT prompts and heads, InternVL adaptation, knowledge integration, CMAFM, decoder and focal-plus-dice loss remain unchanged. Equation (5)'s notation correction does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both evaluate PIADv2 with 15,213 images, 38,889 point clouds, 43 object categories and 24 affordances. Seen, Unseen Object and Unseen Affordance coverage, together with the qualitative test scenarios, is retained.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same Baseline, FRCNN, XMF, IAG and LASO comparisons. Citation additions elsewhere do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Reported partition definitions, 2,048-point annotations, backbones and AUC/aIOU/SIM/MAE metrics are unchanged. Both specify 65 training epochs, batch size 16 and Adam learning rate 1e-4, alongside identical MLLM fine-tuning settings.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the AffCoT, ObjCoT, CMAFM and fine-tuning ablations. The attention visualizations and multiple-object, multiple-affordance and multiple-instance analyses in Figures 5–8 are also retained.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Table 2's relative-improvement reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 retain their numerical entries and rankings. For example, GREAT's Table 2 AUC values remain 91.99, 79.57 and 69.81 across the three partitions. The qualitative experimental results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6) retain the same computations. Equation (5) removes an inconsistent overbar from F_ti and explicitly states the existing per-point output shape. These are notation clarifications, without new mathematical reasoning, assumptions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims: open-vocabulary affordance grounding through geometry-intention reasoning, the GREAT framework, the large PIADv2 dataset and superior benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Section 3.2 changes the geometric rationale from different regions of one object to similar regions across different objects. Section 5.4 removes the explicit inference that Figure 7 demonstrates reasoning beyond category-driven mapping. The computational-cost limitation and proposed distillation remedy remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation and hyperparameter disclosures remain the same. v2 prints the project URL explicitly, but its destination is identical to v1's 'project' hyperlink. Removing a benchmark appendix pointer does not remove any technical details contained in the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: Five references are added, including AffordanceLLM and Learning visual affordance grounding from demonstration videos, while SceneVerse and LOCATE are removed. Citation coverage changes without substantial rewriting of the central research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 corrects typos, standardizes Chain-of-Thought terminology, clarifies feature descriptions and trims several sentences. Affiliations are revised, and email addresses and acknowledgments are added. The section sequence and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: All eight figures and three tables are retained. Figure 3(d)'s caption changes 'affordance category' to 'object category,' matching its axes; other captions receive small corrections. Figure 3's image assets are resized without changing the examples, alongside limited layout reflow.

improvement.justification: v2 removes small sources of confusion by correcting Figure 3(d)'s category description, making Equation (5) consistent with Equation (4), and clarifying the cross-object geometry rationale. These improve clarity and internal consistency. The experimental evidence, principal claims and documented limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
